name: sarathi-sdlc
description: A structured software delivery workflow for AI coding agents

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/package/assemble.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run test:layout
scripts.check:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:markdown && npm run typecheck && npm run test:foundation && npm run test:checkers && npm run test:status && npm run test:distribution && npm run test:installers
scripts.clean: node --eval "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['bundle','dist']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 })"
scripts.clean:test: node --eval "require('node:fs').rmSync('.node-test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 })"
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .markdownlint.json "src/**/*.mts" "tests-node/**/*.mts"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json eslint.config.mjs playwright.config.mjs .prettierrc.json .markdownlint.json "src/**/*.mts" "tests-node/**/*.mts"
scripts.test:distribution: npm run build && npm run build:test && node .node-test-dist/tests-node/run-distribution.mjs
scripts.test:installers: npm run build && npm run build:test && node .node-test-dist/tests-node/run-installers.mjs
